# Masked preview fixtures

Generated by `python3 scripts/masked-preview-fixtures.py OUTPUT_DIRECTORY` using
only the standard library. No external images, fonts or user documents.
`manifest.json` records byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes. Binary header comments
allow Strict opens. Page 1 contains the large masked image; page 2 is an
independent simple vector page for error recovery.

- soft-white/dark/checker: 2665 x 1916 RGB + same-sized 8-bit Gray SMask.
  Alpha regions include zero, 128, 255 and a gradient. Fully transparent base
  samples deliberately have a different color to detect hidden-color bleeding.
- soft-matte: same-sized SMask, white Matte and preblended red; dark background
  reveals incorrect Matte handling.
- soft-different: 3 x 2 Gray SMask with inverse Decode; dark background.
- soft-corrupt: mask's final Adler checksum byte flipped, with intact PDF
  structure and base image. The preview must fail before publication.

Independent engine references are generated separately into ignored output/
using `scripts/masked-preview-references.py`; they are not normative source PDFs.
